SELECT a.*, b.case_name FROM `case_info_approval_form` a JOIN case_info b on b.case_info_id = a.case_info_id
AND b.case_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.caseName}, '%')
AND a.case_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.caseNo}, '%')
AND a.case_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.caseType}, '%')
AND b.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.customerName}, '%')
AND a.approval_status = #{params.approvalStatus}
ORDER BY a.approval_time DESC
